phase_name: Phase 2: Menu Management & POS Order Creation
summary: Architectural analysis and atomic work breakdown structure for Phase 2, implementing zero-float currency precision, ACID order snapshots, RBAC menu protection, and Stitch-grounded POS cashier screens.

backend_tasks.title: Models, Schemas & Data Contracts
backend_tasks.details: SQLAlchemy models with DECIMAL(12,2) currency types for categories, products, product options, orders, and order items. Pydantic DTOs with strict zero-float validation.

backend_tasks.title: Business Logic & Services (ACID & Precision)
backend_tasks.details: Domain services handling menu CRUD and atomic POS order transactions with immutable pricing snapshots (base_price + options) and stock validation.

backend_tasks.title: API Routers, Security & Tests
backend_tasks.details: REST endpoints with RBAC dependencies (MANAGER for menu modifications, CASHIER/MANAGER for orders) and pytest test suite.

frontend_tasks.title: TypeScript Types & API Services
frontend_tasks.details: TypeScript interfaces matching backend DTOs 1:1, authenticated API client services using Axios.

frontend_tasks.title: UI Pages, Components & POS Layout
frontend_tasks.details: Faithful Google Stitch POS and Menu management screens adhering to artisan color palette, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Material Symbols.

acceptance_criteria: Backend tests pass with 0 failures and 0 errors
npm run build passes with 0 TypeScript/Vite errors
Manager role required for menu modifications; Cashier can create orders and view catalog
Order total calculation strictly equals base_price plus sum of selected options using fixed-precision arithmetic
Modifying product catalog prices does not affect historical order item pricing snapshots
